name: markdown-caption
description: Adds ~: captions for any block (images, quotes, code, tables, lists) to VSCode's markdown preview, as <figure> and <figcaption>
author: Drake Costa <drake@saeris.io> (https://saeris.gg)

bumpy.buildCommand: vp pack && vp exec postcss src/caption.css --output dist/caption.css && vp exec vsce package --no-dependencies
